validity.researcher_notes: Existence, name, length, diameter, status, and operator all check out against the sheet's own cited source. elwatannews.com/news/details/8226157 (16 Feb 2026, by-lined reporter Marina Raouf) reports that Petroleum Pipelines Company (شركة أنابيب البترول, i.e. PPC) held a community-consultation session for the environmental-impact assessment of a project to MODIFY THE ROUTE of the crude line 'October-Tibeen' (خط خام أكتوبر-التبين), explicitly stated as diameter 16 inches, length 15 km, in Giza -- an exact match to GEM's Diameter=16in and LengthKnown=15km. The project uses horizontal directional drilling and cathodic-protection systems to reroute the existing line around a conflict with the National Tunnels Authority's works -- i.e. this is a reroute of an ALREADY-EXISTING, in-service crude line, not a new build, which supports Status=operating (the 'operating' token is not verbatim in the source, it is a reasonable inference from 'modifying the route of' an existing asset, not from 'constructing'). PipelineType=transmission is reasonable given both endpoints are industrial/urban nodes (6th of October City in Giza governorate; Tebbin/Helwan area, administratively part of Cairo governorate) rather than a field, consistent with StartState/Province=Giza. Fuel=Oil is directly supported: the source calls it a 'khat kham' (crude line), i.e. crude oil. Operator='Petroleum Pipeline Company(PPC)' is directly and explicitly confirmed -- the company running the project is named in full as 'Sharikat Anabib Al-Petrol' (Petroleum Pipelines Company), with its board chairman (Eng. Hajjaj Kilani) quoted. CAVEAT ON SOURCE INDEPENDENCE: the second URL on this row, a Facebook post from account 100019577036242 (which is PPC's own page), carries the identical press-release wording as the elwatannews article (verified via the FB page's og:description meta tag, which HTML-entity-decodes to the same lede and body text almost verbatim). This is PPC's own announcement of its own event, picked up by one outlet -- i.e. ONE origin (the company's press release / event), not two independent corroborating sources per the project's 2+-independent-source rule. That does not undermine existence (a company's own detailed technical announcement of its own EIA consultation, naming exact diameter/length/location/engineering method, is strong primary-source evidence), but it means the row's true confidence tier is medium (1 strong source), not high. No duplicate found: checked against all 46 rows in the Egypt-oil roster -- no other row shares this name, this 15 km/16 in combination, or these endpoints; the other El-Tibeen-named rows (P7334, P7335, P7325, P7326) are refined-PRODUCTS lines with different lengths/diameters/directions, not crude, so this is not a relabel of any of them.
